title: Locality bounds for initialized oracle runs
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, let $O$ be a language over its symbol alphabet, and let $x$ be an input word. For every $t\in\mathbb{N}$, in the configuration reached after $t$ steps from the initial configuration on $x$, every work-tape head has position of absolute value at most $t$, and every cell $z$ of every one of the $k+1$ work tapes is blank whenever $t\le |z|$.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle machine $M$ with $k$ ordinary work tapes
An oracle language $O$ over the symbol alphabet
Every work-tape head has absolute position at most $t$
Every cell $z$ with $t\le |z|$ is blank on every work tape
replaced:
Let $M$ be an oracle machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, $O$ an oracle
language, and $x$ an input word.  Then for every $t \in \mathbb{N}$, in the
configuration reached by running $M$ with oracle $O$ for $t$ steps from its
initial configuration on $x$: every one of the $k+1$ work heads is at a
position of absolute value at most $t$, and every work-tape cell at an integer
position $z$ with $t \le \abs{z}$ is blank.
